item.title: Renders
item.description:
This project owns reusable 3D render assets together with the reference images that control their likeness and the acceptance evidence bound to exact candidate bytes.

Features

  • Reusable render assets with controlling references
  • Acceptance evidence bound to exact candidate bytes
  • Visual, structural, and animation gates before delivery
